one_line: The paper reports findings from a US DOE Better Plants virtual in-plant training and polling survey about implementing ISO 50001-based energy management systems across general US manufacturing companies, with continuous-process sectors (iron/steel, pulp & paper, ammonia refrigeration) appearing only as cited examples, not as the study's application context.
